title: Abraham and Isaac
summary: God provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 22:1-19 and look for how this passage teaches: God provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply.

tell_it: Abraham obeyed God during a very hard test. God stopped him and provided a ram instead.
understand_it: God provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Abraham and Isaac reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Trust matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Abraham and Isaac shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply.
teen_explanation: Abraham and Isaac gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when trust is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did God provide instead?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: A ram. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 22:14 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Abraham and Isaac?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Provision Search
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Abraham and Isaac. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
